title: Lauri Turkia
text:
PhD Student, Tampere University, affiliated with Finnish Centre of Excellence in Tax Systems Research (FIT) and Education for the Future Flagship (EDUCA)
I am 3rd year PhD student from University of Tampere under supervision of prof. Jarkko Harju and assistant prof. Vesa-Matti Heikkuri. During the 2026-2027 academic year I am visiting Opportunity Insights at Harvard University and my host is prof. Raj Chetty.
